TARGET_URL: https://datajelly.com/

TITLE: DataJelly Guard — Production Monitoring for Your Actual Pages

META_DESCRIPTION: Guard scans your important pages every 30 minutes, runs 30 automated tests, tracks Lighthouse scores, monitors static files, and alerts you the moment something silently breaks. Your site says it is up — Guard proves it still works.

OG_TITLE: DataJelly Guard — Production Monitoring for Your Actual Pages

OG_DESCRIPTION: Guard scans your important pages every 30 minutes, runs 30 automated tests, tracks Lighthouse scores, monitors static files, and alerts you the moment something silently breaks. Your site says it is up — Guard proves it still works.

CANONICAL: https://datajelly.com

HTML_TEXT:
DataJelly Guard — Production Monitoring for Your Actual Pages DJ DataJelly Meet Guard Explore Guard Pricing Guides Tests How to Start Page Audit Dashboard Toggle menu Looking for DataJelly Edge? Edge is now Guard Protect the pages that make you money. Your homepage, pricing, signup, and checkout can return 200 OK and still be broken. Paste any URL and Guard renders it like a real browser, runs 32 checks, and shows you exactly what bots, crawlers, and users actually see. Run free audit Zero code required · No signup · Results in seconds Try one of these: vercel.com stripe.com nextjs.org datajelly.com 32 production checks Scans every 30 min Results in seconds Works with any modern hosting platform Vercel Netlify AWS Azure Webflow Framer Lovable Bolt Shopify What does Guard do? Guard monitors the pages that drive your business — revenue, signups, search visibility, AI understanding. It detects blank renders, content drops, broken metadata, and failed CTAs before they become real problems . From monitoring to protection in four simple steps 1 Monitor We check your key pages every 30 minutes, rendering them like a real browser to see what users actually see. 2 Detect Our 30 signals identify content drops, broken renders, missing CTAs, and SEO issues before they impact users. 3 Alert Get instant notifications via Slack, email, or webhooks when something breaks on your critical pages. 4 Protect Know about issues within minutes of deploy, not days later from angry users or lost revenue. Your most important pages stay healthy. If they break, you find out in minutes — not days. Set up in under 5 minutes. No code changes required. The visibility gap Your server says the site is up. But is it actually working? Modern websites fail in ways that traditional monitoring misses completely. Your uptime dashboard shows green while customers, Google, and AI tools see something completely broken. Blank Pages Page loads but shows nothing. The server thinks it worked. Users see white. Missing Content Buttons disappear. Pricing vanishes. Forms break. All while the site stays up. Hidden from Google Accidental noindex tags, canonical changes, or sitemap errors tank your traffic. Broken Dependencies Third-party scripts fail, auth providers error, CDN issues cascade to users. Ready to protect your key pages? Start your free 10 -day trial. No credit card required. Start free trial Where every other tool stops Guard catches what nothing else does. It's the page-level truth layer your stack can't see. The layer between “server is up” and “the page actually works.” Most failures that cost you traffic and revenue happen after the server responds OK. Failure Mode Uptime APM SEO Crawler Synthetic Guard Server returns OK HTTP-level reachability Backend errors / slow API Server-side faults and latency Page renders blank after deploy Server OK, but DOM is empty JavaScript crash on load React shell renders, app never boots Visible text dropped Content quietly disappears from rendered page Primary CTA missing Pricing or signup button gone after a release noindex tag added accidentally A dev config leaks to production Canonical URL changed SEO authority silently re-routed Critical bundle failed to load Third-party or CDN script never arrives Checkout silently broken Form renders but payment never submits Social preview broken OG tags missing or wrong on share AI-readable content lost LLM crawlers see an empty shell Catches it - Partial / depends on setup - Blind to it Keep your APM. Keep your SEO suite. Guard is the missing layer that proves — page by page, deploy by deploy — that what you shipped is actually what your customers and crawlers see. The solution Guard watches what actually matters. Guard is the safety layer between “ship it” and “why is conversion down?” — for teams that can't afford to learn about broken pages from customers. Page-level monitoring Homepage, pricing, signup, checkout, docs — any URL you can't afford to break silently. Scans every 30 min Recurring checks, not one-off audits. Fresh proof your pages still work, all day, every day. Captures the truth Screenshot, HTML, AI Markdown, Lighthouse, static files — stored on every scan. Alerts that matter Pages roll up to worst test. You get context and evidence, not noise. What Guard runs 32 automated tests. Zero scripts to write. 8 categories of production checks run on every page, every scan — from “is it even reachable” to “did the deploy silently break your content.” 6 Availability Is the page even reachable? 5 Render Integrity Did the page actually render? 5 Content Stability Did the content silently change? 7 Critical Signals Are your SEO & AI signals intact? 4 Performance Is the page fast enough? 3 Dependencies Did a third party break you? 1 Interaction Can users actually convert? 1 Security Is anything tampering with the page? Every check explains what broke, why it happened, and exactly how to fix it. Explore the full test catalog Platform Features
